items.docs: Creates a delivery order for a previously reserved time slot. The order includes the cart items and delivery details. Orders should be created as soon as possible after the time slot is reserved.

items.docs: Cancels a delivery, pickup, or last mile delivery order. To successfully cancel, the order status must be brand_new. Once a shopper is assigned and the status moves to acknowledged, the order can no longer be canceled through this endpoint.
